faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by All India Institute of Medical Sciences Rishikesh (AIIMS Rishikesh) for an ICMR-funded collaborative research project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The post advertised is Project Research Scientist-I under the research field for project-based employment in Uttarakhand.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for AIIMS Rishikesh Project Research Scientist-I Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Research Scientist-I position in this recruitment cycle.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Research Scientist-I post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Ph.D. in Biotechnology, Life Sciences, Bioinformatics, Microbiology, Molecular Biology, or allied disciplines with at least 2 years of post-Ph.D. research experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Research Scientist-I post will receive a salary of ₹58,800/- per month plus 10% HRA.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of the application via email is 10-10-2026. Candidates must ensure applications reach the destination on time.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for AIIMS Rishikesh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly via email. Candidates need to send their CV, cover letter, publications, and certificates to [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Research Scientist-I position comprises an interview conducted by the selection committee at AIIMS Rishikesh.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee has been specified or mentioned in the official notification released by AIIMS Rishikesh for this project post.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF and application details?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification details, email submission guidelines, and important links directly on this page under the respective sections.
